## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact.

## Root cause and scope

Explain the defect or requirement, the affected package(s), and what is deliberately out of scope.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, production data, or private infrastructure details are included.
- [ ] Trust boundaries, privileges, TLS, credentials, parsing, output, files, and failure behavior were reviewed.
- [ ] Checkmk compatibility metadata is evidence-based and synchronized.
- [ ] Saved-rule, service-name, metric, item, and value-store compatibility was considered.

## Documentation

- [ ] Package README and operational instructions are current.
- [ ] Check manuals and rule help match behavior.
- [ ] Non-obvious public code and security invariants have useful docstrings/comments.
- [ ] Upgrade, migration, rollback, troubleshooting, and removal implications are documented.

## Validation

List focused tests, repository checks, Checkmk validation, fixtures, and any remaining live-system validation.
